descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS (SG)-specific stop response (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the SLS-specific stop response for the function "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS). These settings apply to the individual limit values for SLS. In the case of encoderless motion monitoring (p9306 = 1), only a value of 0 or 1 is permitted.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion standstill tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS setpoint velocity limiting (Control Unit)
descriere: This is an evaluation factor to define the setpoint limit from the selected actual speed limit. The active SLS limit value is evaluated with this factor and is made available as setpoint limit in r9733:

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SCA (SN) tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Cam" (SCA). Within this tolerance, both monitoring channels may signal different signal states of the same safe cam.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value comparison tolerance (referencing) (CU)
descriere: Sets the tolerance to check the actual values after referencing (incremental encoder) or when powering up (abso- lute encoder).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM (SGA n < nx) velocity hysteresis (CU)
descriere: Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion slip velocity tolerance (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance that is used for a 2-encoder system in crosswise comparison between the two monitor- ing channels.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SGE changeover tolerance time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the tolerance time for the changeover of the safety-related inputs (SGE).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP D to SOS (SBH) (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP D to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP F to STOP B (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP F to STOP B.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression shutdown velocity (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the shutdown velocity for pulse suppression. Below this velocity "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, the pulses are suppressed (by changing to STOP A). In the case of encoderless motion monitoring functions, the parameter must be > 0 (recommended value: 10).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression test time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the time after which the pulses must have been suppressed when initiating the test stop.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion forced checking procedure timer (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the time to carry out the forced checking procedure and test the safety motion monitoring functions integrated in the drives. Within the parameterized time, the safety functions must have been tested at least once (including deselection of the "STO" function). This monitoring time is reset each time the test is carried out. The signal source to initiate the forced checking procedure is set in p9705.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion: Test stop signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the test stop of the safety-relevant motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS (SG) stop response (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the stop response for the function "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS). This setting applies for all SLS limit values. An input value of less than 5 signifies personnel protection, from 10 and upwards, machine protection.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion pulse suppression delay time after bus failure (CU)
descriere: Sets the delay time after which the pulses are safely suppressed after a bus failure.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SBR velocity limit (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the "SBR" function. SBR is deactivated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode (Control Unit)
descriere: Setting to select and deselect the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test status (Control Unit)
descriere: Displays the status of the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9581 (reference value) and p9583 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val sensing encoderless filter time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with encoderless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion voltage tolerance acceleration (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the voltage tolerance for suppressing acceleration peaks. Increasing this percentage value means that voltage peaks will need to have a higher amplitude during acceleration procedures if they are not to affect actual value sensing. - The value must be increased if C1711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if acceleration procedures have led to an excessive safety actual velocity.

descriere_scurta: SI enable Safe Brake Control (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the enable signal for the function "Safe Brake Control" (SBC) on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI PROFIsafe address (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the PROFIsafe address of the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI STO/SBC/SS1 debounce time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the CU DI debounce time used to control the SH terminal (see p9620). The debounce time is accepted rounded to whole milliseconds. The debounce time indicates the maximum duration of a fault pulse on the F-DIs, so that there are no negative effects on the SGEs.

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Stop 1 delay time (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the delay time of the pulse suppression for the function "Safe Stop 1" (SS1) on the Control Unit to brake along the OFF3 down ramp (p1135).

descriere_scurta: SI transition time STOP F to STOP A (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition period from STOP F to STOP A on the Motor Module.

descriere_scurta: SI transition time STOP F to STOP A (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the transition period from STOP F to STOP A on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI forced checking procedure timer
descriere: Sets the time to carry out the dynamic update and testing the safety shutdown paths (forced checking procedure). Within the parameterized time, STO must have been deselected at least once. The monitoring time is reset each time that STO is deselected.

descriere_scurta: SI forced checking procedure remaining time
descriere: Displays the time remaining before dynamization and testing of the safety shutdown paths (forced checking proce- dure).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion copy function
descriere: Setting to start the required copy function. After starting, the appropriate parameters are copied from the Control Unit to the Motor Module. Once copying is complete, the parameter is automatically reset to 0.

descriere_scurta: Acknowledge SI Motion data
descriere: Setting to transfer the reference checksums from the associated actual checksums after changes (SI parameters, hardware). After transferring the reference checksums, parameters are automatically reset to 0.

descriere_scurta: SI reference checksum SI parameters (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the checksum for the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Motor Module (reference checksum).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion diagnostics position action value motor side
descriere: Displays the actual motor-side position actual value for the motion monitoring functions on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion user agreement, inside the drive
descriere: Displays the internal state of the user agreement. Value = 0: User agreement is not set. Value = AC hex: User agreement is set.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual checksum, SI parameters
descriere: Displays the checksum over the checked Safety Integrated parameters of the motion monitoring functions (actual checksum). Index: [0] = Checksum over SI parameters for motion monitoring [1] = Checksum over SI parameters for actual values [2] = Checksum over SI parameters for HW

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Safe maximum velocity
descriere: Displays the safe maximum velocity (on the load side) that is permissible for the safe motion monitoring functions as a result of the actual value sensing. If safety is not enabled, the parameter has no significance and is set to "0".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion safe position accuracy
descriere: Displays the safe position accuracy (on the load side) that can be achieved as a maximum for the safe motion mon- itoring functions as a result of the actual value sensing. If safety is not enabled, the parameter has no significance and is set to "0".

descriere_scurta: SI message buffer changes, counter
descriere: Displays the changes of the safety message buffer. This counter is incremented every time that the safety message buffer changes.

descriere_scurta: SI message cases, counter
descriere: Number of safety messages that have occurred since the last reset.

descriere_scurta: SI password input
descriere: Enters the Safety Integrated password.

descriere_scurta: SI password acknowledgement
descriere: Acknowledges the new Safety Integrated password.

descriere_scurta: SI status list (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the Safety Integrated status on the Motor Module.

descriere_scurta: SI status (Control Unit + Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the Safety Integrated status on the drive (Control Unit + Motor Module).

descriere_scurta: SI monitoring clock cycle (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the clock cycle time for the Safety Integrated Basic Functions on the Motor Module.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion min current act val sensing encoderless (Control Unit) /
descriere: Sets the minimum current for encoderless actual value sensing. Reducing this percentage value can adversely affect actual value sensing. - The value must be increased if C1711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if C1711 has occurred with message value 1041.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion diagnostics
descriere: The parameter is used for diagnostics.

descriere_scurta: SI actual checksum SI parameters (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the checksum for the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Motor Module (actual checksum).

descriere_scurta: SI reference checksum SI parameters (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the checksum for the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Control Unit (reference checksum).

descriere_scurta: = 1) is not practical if there is no motor holding brake.
descriere: Sets the time to open the motor holding brake. After controlling the holding brake (opens), the speed/velocity setpoint remains at zero for this time. After this, the speed/velocity setpoint is enabled.

descriere_scurta: SI STO/SBC/SS1 debounce time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the debounce time for the EP terminal of the Motor Module. The debounce time is rounded to whole milliseconds. The debounce time indicates the maximum duration of a fault pulse on the F-DIs, so that there are no negative effects on the SGEs.

descriere_scurta: SI Safe Stop 1 delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time of the pulse suppression for the function "Safe Stop 1" (SS1) on the Motor Module to brake along the OFF3 down ramp (p1135).

descriere_scurta: SI diagnostics STOP F (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the number of the cross-checked data which has caused STOP F on the Motor Module.

descriere_scurta: SI version safety functions integrated in drive (Motor Module)
descriere: Displays the Safety Integrated version for the safety functions integrated in the drive on the Motor Module. Index: [0] = Safety Version (major release) [1] = Safety Version (minor release) [2] = Safety Version (baselevel or patch) [3] = Safety Version (hotfix)

descriere_scurta: Target topology number of indices
descriere: Sets the number of target topology indices.

descriere_scurta: Topology comparison, acknowledge differences
descriere: If, when comparing the actual topology and target topology, only error has occurred, that can be acknowledged, then using this parameter, a new comparison can be started - acknowledging the error in the target topology. Differences that can be acknowledged: - topology comparison, component shifted - topology comparison, serial number of a component has been detected to be different (byte 3 = 1) - topology comparison shows one component that is connected differently The following parameter values are available:

descriere_scurta: Device specialization
descriere: With p9905 = 1, the serial numbers and the hardware versions of all of the components are transferred from the actual topology into the target topology and a new comparison is started.. For this device specialization, the components of the target topology may only differ from those of the actual topol- ogy by the serial numbers. With p9905 = 2, the serial numbers, the hardware versions and the order numbers of all of the components are transferred from the actual topology into the target topology and a new comparison is started.. For this device specialization, the components of the target topology may only differ from those of the actual topol- ogy by the serial numbers and order numbers.

descriere_scurta: Topology comparison, comparison stage of all components
descriere: Sets the type of comparison between the actual topology and target topology. The comparison is started by setting the required value.

descriere_scurta: Topology comparison, comparison stage of a component
descriere: Sets the type of comparison of a component in the target topology with the actual topology. The comparison is started by setting the required value.

descriere_scurta: Transfer additional components into the target topology
descriere: Transfer additional inserted DRIVE-CLiQ components into the target topology and add the appropriate drive objects to the project.

descriere_scurta: DRIVE-CLiQ data transfer error shutdown threshold master
descriere: Only for internal Siemens service purposes.

descriere_scurta: DRIVE-CLiQ data transfer error shutdown threshold slave
descriere: Only for internal Siemens service purposes.

descriere_scurta: Licensing, enter license key
descriere: Enters the license key for this drive unit. Example of the license key: EACZ-QBCA = 69 65 67 90 45 81 66 67 65 dec (ASCII characters) Index 0 = license key character 1 (e.g. 69 dec) Index 1 = license key character 2 (e.g. 65 dec) ... Index 19 = license key character 20 (e.g. 0 dec) With the STARTER commissioning software, ASCII characters are not entered coded, i.e. the characters of the license key can be entered as printed in the Certificate of License. In this case, STARTER codes the characters.

descriere_scurta: Firmware check status
descriere: Displays the status when the firmware is checked when the system is booted. 0: Firmware not yet checked. 1: Check running. 2: Check successfully completed. 3: Check indicates an error.

descriere_scurta: Save system logbook EEPROM
descriere: Only for service purposes.

descriere_scurta: Target topology feature delete all components
descriere: Writing the parameter to the value 1 deletes (sets to zero) the serial numbers of all components in the target topol- ogy. Through activation and deactivation this enables the actual topology components to be newly assigned to the target topology components.

descriere_scurta: Sampling times utilization measured
descriere: Displays the utilizations measured for the active sampling times. Index: [0] = Net utilization 0 [1] = Total utilization 0 [2] = Net utilization 1 [3] = Total utilization 1 [4] = Net utilization 2 [5] = Total utilization 2 [6] = Net utilization 3 [7] = Total utilization 3 [8] = Net utilization 4 [9] = Total utilization 4 [10] = Net utilization 5 [11] = Total utilization 5 [12] = Net utilization 6 [13] = Total utilization 6

descriere_scurta: System utilization
descriere: Displays the system utilization. If the utilization is greater than 100%, fault F01054 is output. Index: [0] = Reserved [1] = Computing time utilization [2] = Reserved [3] = Reserved [4] = Reserved [5] = Largest total utilization [6] = Reserved [7] = Reserved

descriere_scurta: DO selection for memory usage actual value determination /
descriere: The meaning of the parameter differs for reading and writing: Read: Returns the number of memory areas monitored. Write: Memory usage of a drive object: Enter the drive object ID. Memory usage of the complete system: Enter value 65535.

descriere_scurta: SI sampling time
descriere: Sets the sampling time for the Terminal Module 54F (TM54F).

descriere_scurta: SI delay time for test stop at DO 0 ... DO 3
descriere: Sets the wait time for testing the digital outputs 0 ... 3 (DO 0 ... DO 3). Within this time, for a forced checking procedure of the digital outputs, the signal must have been detected via the corresponding digital input DI 20 ... DI 23.

descriere_scurta: SI discrepancy monitoring time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time for the discrepancy for the digital inputs. The signal states at the two associated digital inputs (F-DI) must assume the same state within this monitoring time.

descriere_scurta: SI test sensor feedback signal input DI 20 ... 23
descriere: Sets the test of the feedback line for forced checking procedure.

descriere_scurta: SI acknowledgement internal event input terminal
descriere: Select a safety-relevant digital input for the signal "acknowledge internal event" (internal fault). The signal is transferred to the corresponding control signal of all drives. The falling edge at this input resets the status "internal event" in the drives.

descriere_scurta: SI operating mode TM54F
descriere: Sets the operating mode for the Terminal Module 54F (TM54F).

descriere_scurta: SI Motor Module Node Identifier Word 3
descriere: Sets the current Node Identifier (word 3, bit 64 ... 95) for the Motor Modules. Index: [0] = Drive 1 [1] = Drive 2 [2] = Drive 3 [3] = Drive 4 [4] = Drive 5 [5] = Drive 6

descriere_scurta: CU inputs/outputs, sampling time
descriere: Sets the sampling time for the inputs and outputs. Index: [0] = Digital inputs/outputs (DI/DO) [1] = Not available - analog inputs (AI) [2] = Not available - analog outputs (AO)

descriere_scurta: SI digital inputs debounce time
descriere: Parameter setting for the debounce time of the F-DIs and single-channel DIs of the TM54F. The debounce time is rounded to whole mS. The debounce time indicates the maximum duration of a fault pulse on the FDIs, so that there are no negative effects on the SGEs.

descriere_scurta: SI Emergency Stop stop response
descriere: Sets the stop response for the drive group for Emergency Stop. The input terminal for Emergency Stop is set in p10038. 0 = Stop reaction STO 1 = Stop reaction SS1 2 = Stop reaction SS2

descriere_scurta: SI F-DI input mode
descriere: Sets the input mode for the safety-relevant input terminals of terminal series 2.

descriere_scurta: SI F-DI enable for test
descriere: Enable signal for the integration of F-DI in the test (forced checking procedure) of the sensor power supply.

descriere_scurta: SI selection of test mode for test stop
SI TM54F failsafe events active
descriere: Displays the events that lead to the transfer of failsafe signals to all drives assigned to the TM54F. If the second channel of the TM54F transmits failsafe signals, then these are synchronized to the other channel. Possibilities of resolving the situation: - error during test stop: correctly perform the test stop. - internal software error: no possibility of resolving this problem, POWER ON. - internal synchronization problem: no possibility of resolving this problem, POWER ON. - all other causes: remove the cause of the error and carry out a safety-relevant acknowledgement (p10006).

descriere_scurta: SI password acknowledgement TM54F
descriere: Acknowledgement of the new Safety Integrated password for the Terminal Module 54F (TM54F).

descriere_scurta: SI password new TM54F
descriere: Enters the new Safety Integrated password for the Terminal Module 54F (TM54F).

descriere_scurta: Activate BOP user-defined list
descriere: Setting for activating/deactivating the user-defined list for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP). If p0016 = 1, then it is only possible to access parameters in the parameter list (p0013).

descriere_scurta: Reset energy consumption display
descriere: Setting to reset the energy consumption display (r0039). Procedure: Set p0040 = 0 --> 1. The display is reset and the parameter is automatically set to zero.

descriere_scurta: Select drive object type
descriere: Executes an automatic device configuration. In so doing, p0099, p0107 and p0108 are appropriately set.

descriere_scurta: Current controller computing dead time mode
descriere: Sets the mode for the computing dead time of the current controller. 0: Offset (shifted) clocking, minimum computing dead time of each drive, automatic setting 1: Clocking at the same time, the dead time aligns itself to the dead time of the latest drive, automatic setting 2: Manual setting of the computing dead time, early transfer 3: Manual setting of the computing dead time, late transfer 4-6: As for 0-2, however, no early transfers are set for vectors

descriere_scurta: Power unit motor reactor
descriere: Enter the inductance of a filter connected at the power unit output.

descriere_scurta: Maximum operating time power unit fan
descriere: Sets the maximum operating time of the power unit fan. The pre-alarm (warning) is output 500 hours before this set value. The monitoring is deactivated with p0252 = 0.

descriere_scurta: Cooling system, starting time 1
descriere: Sets starting time 1 to monitor the cooling system after power-on command. After powering up, the following signals must be present within starting time 1: - "RKA powered up" - "RKA liquid flow OK" When a fault occurs, an appropriate message is output.

descriere_scurta: Cooling system, fault conductivity delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the fault "RKA: Conductive limit value exceeded" during operation. The fault is only output if, during operation, the conductivity exceeds the permissible fault value and the value remains for a longer time than is set in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: Fan run-on time
descriere: Sets the fan run-on time after the pulses for the power unit have been canceled.

descriere_scurta: Measuring probe 1 input terminal
descriere: Sets the input terminal to connect probe 1.

descriere_scurta: Equivalent zero mark, input terminal
descriere: Selects the input terminal for connecting an equivalent zero mark (external encoder zero mark).

descriere_scurta: Inhibit automatic reference value calculation
descriere: Inhibits the calculation of reference parameters (e.g. p2000) when automatically calculating the motor and closed- loop control parameters (p0340, p3900).

descriere_scurta: Motor temperature signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source to evaluate the motor temperature via a BICO interconnection.
